place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
We throughly enjoyed our experience with XO Tours from start to finish. The communication throughout the booking, confirmation and pick-up process, all the way to the follow-up email including wonderful pics of our time on the tours - makes it clear that this company is well-organized, customer-focused and professionally run. We are very glad that we booked with XO and loved both, the evening Foodie Tour and Sights Of Saigon the following day. Seeing and experiencing the city on the back of a motorbike is absolutely the way to go. And in the hands of the WONDERFUL women who drive, guide and share what their city has to offer, makes it a very fun and engaging experience. We always felt safe and learned a lot about the culture & history whilst filling our bellies to the brim with delicious local food.
*And they go the extra mile: My husband accidentally hurt his leg (his mistake) mid-tour and when we arrived at the next location, one of the tour assistants had gone to the pharmacy and gave us some ointment to make sure it was taken care of quickly and properly. This is the kind of attentive service that makes XO special and shows that they truly care about their customers and our experience.
We can’t recommend these tours enough, so if you’re considering it…go for it. We did and it was one of the highlights of our time in Vietnam. A big THANK YOU again to the smart, funny, engaging and caring ladies who took us around town - we truly appreciate your hard work and the memories we made with you. Cam on!

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
This tour ended up being one of the absolute highlights of our entire Vietnam trip. By chance, it was just our family of eight—ranging from my 11‑year‑old daughter all the way up to my mother (age politely withheld). Most of us had never been on a motorbike before, and certainly not in the kind of wild, exhilarating Saigon traffic you get to experience on this tour.

We originally booked it hoping for some tasty local food and a bit of city exploring. What completely blew us away was the guides’ energy, enthusiasm, and genuine warmth. From the moment they picked us up, they clearly explained the plan for the night and walked us through how to ride safely, making sure anyone feeling nervous was paired with a guide who’d keep them comfortable.

By the time we zipped through traffic to the first stop, everyone was buzzing—not just from the ride, but from how friendly and fun the guides were. Then came our first dish: a crab tapioca noodle soup with a rich, deeply flavoured broth and chillis on the side so everyone could dial in their preferred heat level. It was absolutely delicious. One member of our group had dietary restrictions, and the team accommodated them seamlessly.

As the night went on, we rode to a few more spots—and then the rain arrived in full force. The guides handed out ponchos, and we splashed our way through Saigon, eating, laughing, and soaking up the chaos and charm of the city together.

Do yourself a favour and book this tour. The food was fantastic. Riding through Saigon at night was unforgettable. And the tour guides were simply exceptional.

review_text: An XO Food and City Tour with this amazing company is a MUST DO in Saigon. Stops 2 and 4 were to give you time inbetween eating whilst showing you another part of the city.  We walked through China town and the Korean area, both were very interesting and very different from each other.  The woman running the tour have thought of everything.  They had clearly thought about who they sat myself and my husband with to eat, the conversations they had with us, the food we ate, they cooked food at the table for us, even retrieved the crab meat from the shells for us.  There were people taking photos throughout and it was wonderful to received a dropbox file with all photos which included us.  Overall a fantastic, exceptional experience.

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
I did the XO Sights of Saigon and the XO Saigon by Night tours. They were truly the best way to see Saigon. The morning tour truly brought the history of Viet Nam alive. It was wonderful to understand the significance behind the different styles of buildings etc. It is always amazing to see the places that significant historical events took place and to take a moment to reflect. What I truly love about Viet Nam and its people is there endurance and positivity.  The love the ladies have for their country is obvious and to be honest they made me love the country and its people too.

The XO at night tour was also very good I love walking through fruit and veg markets and they didnt mind explaining what some of the produce was. What I truly loved was they bought some of the different fruits so we could try after our dinner.

I have a severe shellfish allergy and the ladies were absolutely wonderful in both the am and the evening tour to ensure I could safely partake and eat my fill. Go hungry the amount of food was immense and very filling.

In the day tour we also got to try different drinks which was so good. Although I was very sugared out at the end. If you like sweet drinks you will be smiling all the way.

I really loved the home vist to the apartment to see how people tend to live in HCM in Viet Nam and something as incredible as a smooth cement ramp in the staircase for motorbikes was incredible to see I still havent grasped how peoole can drive up and down it without smashing into the wall on the midlanding as that turn is tight.

The ladies themselves are friendly inclusive and take photos for you so you can truly just have a blast and be present in the moment.

One of my faves was definately the Pagoda with all the Buddhas.

The ladies keep a good pace but you dont feel rushed which I appreciated. I must have looked a bit overheated it was hot and no problem. Out comes the best little portable fan.  No comment etc just turned on and quitely given. Those little kindnesses go a long way and my extremely sweaty red face was most thankful for the cooling.

Definatly do these tours there are some hidden gems I would never have known about and would have never seen.

Thanks XO for everything, that was a morning and night of the most treasured memories for me. Thank you for sharing your beautiful Country and City with me I will treasure this experience.

However, every tour gives you a taste of real local life. I personally loved being able to view the streets of Saigon on the back of the notorbike, it really gives the city a whole new perspective.

XO Tours has absolutely earned their 5 star rating and I highly recommend it for anyone visiting Saigon, even if it's not your first time.

review_text:
We absolutely loved the foodie tour with XO Tours! A special shout-out to Chi, Anh & Dung, who drove us around Saigon on their scooters for more than four hours, taking us to some fantastic local food spots. Their team leader, Sunny, was also great. They were all incredibly friendly, attentive and full of interesting information about the food, the city and local life.

I’ve done a foodie tour with another company in Saigon before. It was cheaper, but honestly, it wasn’t great. They took me to places serving food that you can easily find in Sydney, Australia. At one point, I actually told them, “I’ve had better Bánh mì and Phở in Sydney!” 😂 Not exactly what you want to hear on a food tour in Vietnam!

XO Tours costs a little more, but it is absolutely worth it. The food was much more interesting and varied, with plenty of seafood, fresh fruit, local dishes and, of course, beer... because apparently eating your way around Saigon is thirsty work. 🍻😂

The girls were fantastic and made us feel welcome from start to finish. It was a great way to explore Saigon, eat some seriously good food and discover places we definitely wouldn’t have found on our own.

I highly recommend the XO Tours foodie tour. I’ll definitely be trying some of their other tours next time I’m in Saigon — although knowing how good the food was, I might just end up doing this one again!

Thanks again, Chi, Anh, Dung & Sunny, for an awesome evening and a very full stomach! 😆

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
One of the best things we did on our trip to Vietnam and probably the best tour I've ever been on!! The woman running this tour are knowledgeable, safe drivers, wonderful facilitators, funny, warm, talented, and lovely to spend time with! I enjoyed talking with my guide as we drove around on our scooter and got to see different districts in Saigon. It is also VERY exhilarating be driven around on the scooters!

The food was incredible and well-paced, although because the first soup was so delicious and I ate it all, I was very full by the end. The portions are good in the second and third food stops, adapted to the fact that you've been eating more. We tried fresh local fruits, all kinds of different meats and seafood (some freshly grilled for us by our guides), etc. I tried everything and everything was DELICIOUS.

I really appreciated the commentary on life in Saigon/HCMC these days, what gentrification and inequality looks like, and how the Vietnamese people are adapting to these realities. I always appreciate some real talk and Sunny (our leader) did a great job of balancing more difficult topics with a lighthearted tour -- this is hard to do and I really admire how she navigated the conversation. She and the other guides are rock stars! Do this tour, you will not regret it!! !

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
We were a family of four—my wife, our two teenage sons (16 and 19), and myself—and the XO Foodie Tour was one of the absolute highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

None of us had much experience riding on the back of a scooter, so we were a little nervous at first. Those concerns disappeared within minutes. The female drivers were incredibly skilled,, and stayed together as a group, making the ride feel both secure and exciting. Exploring Ho Chi Minh City this way was an unforgettable experience in itself.

The food was outstanding. My family and I are already big fans of Vietnamese cuisine in Canada, yet every single dish we tasted was completely new to us. The guides took the time to explain each dish, its name, its ingredients, its origins. We discovered authentic local specialties we would never have ordered on our own.

One of the things we appreciated most was that this wasn’t just a food tour—it was also a cultural experience. Between food stops, we visited different neighborhoods and enjoyed short sightseeing walks that gave us time to digest while learning about the city’s history and character. It created the perfect balance between eating and exploring.

The guides were exceptionally caring and attentive. They carefully accommodated everyone’s food preferences and dietary restrictions, constantly checked that we had enough to eat and drink, and made sure everyone was happy.

What truly sets XO apart is the personal attention. The guides don’t just bring you from place to place—they sit with you, prepare and serve the food, answer every question, and make sure you feel completely taken care of throughout the evening. Since they all speak  English, it feels like having your own personal host sitting beside you at every stop, making the entire experience effortless and enjoyable.

We laughed a lot, learned a lot, and ate far more incredible food than we thought possible. The XO Foodie Tour exceeded every expectation we had and gave us an authentic side of Ho Chi Minh City that we could never have experienced on our own.

I wholeheartedly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. If you want to discover the city’s incredible food culture in a fun,, and genuinely authentic way, don’t miss it.

review_text:
If you're coming to Ho Chi Minh City and don't book a motorbike street food tour with XO Tours...you're doing Vietnam wrong! 😂
Hands down, this was one of the absolute highlights of our Vietnam trip.
There were seven of us in our group, and each of us had our own fabulous rider and guide. A huge shout-out to Yen, Xuan, Phuong, Linh, Dieu, Hang and Phuong...you ladies are absolute superstars! ❤️
I'll admit, the thought of hopping on the back of a scooter in Saigon traffic was a little terrifying...for about 30 seconds! 🤣 Then we were off, weaving through what looked like beautifully organised chaos, and loving every second of it.
The best part? Not one of the seven of us felt unsafe for even a moment. Our riders were incredibly skilled, professional and attentive, and we had complete confidence in them from start to finish. If you're nervous about the scooters, don't be—you're in very capable hands.
We stopped at several local street food spots, and every single one was a winner. The food was authentic, fresh and absolutely delicious—the kind of places you'd never stumble across on your own. Every stop had us saying, "How is this so good?" 🤤
But what truly made the evening unforgettable were our guides. They were knowledgeable, funny, warm, passionate about their city, and genuinely cared that we had the best experience possible. By the end of the tour, it felt less like we'd been on a tour and more like we'd spent the evening exploring Saigon with a group of new friends.
To our amazing seven ladies...thank you for the laughs, the stories, the incredible food, and the memories we'll be talking about for years to come. You made an already fantastic city even more special.
If you're visiting Ho Chi Minh City, do yourself a favour and book this tour. Trust me...your taste buds (and your camera roll!) will thank you. 🛵🇻🇳❤️
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 10/10. We'd do it again in a heartbeat!
PS: To our families...yes, we survived Saigon traffic, and now we all think we're professional pillion passengers! 🤣

review_text:
We thought it was a food tour…it was so much more.

Candidly, when I booked XO tours, I thought I was booking a cool way for my wife and me to eat around Saigon/Ho Chi Minh. That’s not what I got, and I am beyond grateful. What we got was laughter, great food, story telling, history and life long memories.

Trinh and Yen, thank you for being our guides, caretakers, scooter racers, and friends for the evening. I really do hope that fate somehow has you visiting Los Angeles so we can repay the favor.

For those wondering, “Which tour do I take?” I have your answer. XO.

This is a wonderful, woman-owned company. Yes, we ate amazing food and drank to our hearts' content, but I’d be doing a disservice to those deciding what to do if I didn’t explain why XO is the right tour, beyond just the food.

We explored Saigon. Its history. It’s people. It’s architecture—the stories of those people, and wonderfully, our guides. The women of Vietnam are amazing with each on their own personal journey and blending of an ancient culture and modern world.

We heard about their backgrounds from the rural areas. The mountains, for one. The Mekong Delta for the other. Their dreams, stories, hopes, and dreams. It was beyond beautiful. But it’s easy to tell stories, you feel that they want to know ours. Who we were. What we did back home. What we thought of their country and the city we explored. At the end, we wanted more so much so that we will return.

If I have to pick a favorite spot we ate at, it would be Mafia Town (district 4, if I remember correctly) and the amazing seafood. It was beyond cool to be with the locals and see them just be together. All that said, I’d say the best was being on the scooter and having great discussions with Trinh. My wife felt the same about Yen. Their personal friendship, smiles, laughter, and overall joy in their own experiences left me…fulfilled. Corny, I know, but I’m left with tears in my eyes as I write this and remember.

To those who come next to this great experience, enjoy! Embrace it with everything you’ve got. You will not be disappointed. I’m jealous.

Trinh, Yen and the entire XO family. A million thanks. May you enjoy long life and wealth.

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
If you’re in Ho Chi Minh City and you don’t do a night scooter tour with XO Tours, you’re missing the city entirely. This wasn’t a tour, it was an immersion and one of the best things we did in Vietnam.

Within minutes, you’re on the back of a scooter, slipping like a fish into the vast shoal of scooters and traffic that feels like chaos and choreography at the same time.

And the riders? Absolutely fabulous. Smart, funny, stylish, completely in command of their bikes and their city. There’s something quietly radical about an all-female team doing this with such confidence and flair - not as a statement, just as a fact. We talked about everything from food to relationships to life in Vietnam, and it never felt like a script. Just real conversation, real connection, and a lot of laughter. You don’t feel like a customer. You feel like you’ve been temporarily adopted by a group of brilliant women.

My guide (who patiently fastened my helmet every single time) carried me through the city like I belonged there.

And then it opens up.

A local market with no tourists. Chinatown alive with stories. Street food I wouldn’t have known how to find in a million years. Drinks that were gloriously, unapologetically too sweet.

But the real moment, and the one I’ll never forget, was visiting Tiny Uncle's small apartment, once home to 14 people. Every inch of space negotiated, every surface used. And yet, we were welcomed with water, seats, and genuine warmth. No performance. Just life, shared.

On the way in, our guide quietly helped an elderly man who’d run out of fuel. No fuss. No drama. Just kindness as a reflex. And that’s what XO Tours does differently. They don’t just show you a pretty version of HCMC, they show you a real one. Complex, generous, resilient, and alive.

I laughed, I learned, I nearly cried, and yes, I sang Born to be Wild on the back of a scooter in Saigon traffic.

Unforgettable.

Do it!

review_text:
We were encouraged to undertake this tour by our Australian travel agent on a recent visit to Ho Chi Minh City. We were not disappointed. Initially we were a little apprehensive given our ages - three old men aged 78, 75 and 69. The oldest was worried about getting on and off the scooters, but after a little practice this was not an issue. We were also concerned about the crazy traffic in that city, but our young female riders negotiated the traffic with skill, safety, confidence and determination. So whatever age you are do not be perturbed.

The amount and variety of food was superb. As announced the locations were local and the food not cliched. We had three food stops. The first offering was a wonderful (non pho) soup. Such subtle flavours. Our second stop offered a combination of barbecued meats  and vegetable dishes grilled at the table by our scooter drivers - again delicious. The third stop was a variety of seafood dishes at a totally local venue providing different tastes and culinary experiences.

This tour provided an extensive night tour from venue to venue, and we saw parts of the city we would not otherwise see as tourists.

We would particularly like to compliment our three guides: Nhu4, Sam and Autumn. They were extremely poised and confident young women with good senses of humour. We were part of a larger group of about 13 guests, and the head guide for this group was Yen. She was an engaging leader and an informative guide who gave us great insights into the city of Ho Chi Minh City.

We organised this tour on line while in Australia and it was very straightforward with good back office organisation and communication.

Whoever you are do not hesitate to do this tour. It is not only a great experience, but it also assists young women to break into the tourist industry.

review_text:
I booked the Sights of Saigon tour with XO Tours and I have nothing but positive to say.
We had the entire tour to ourselves (group of 2).
Như and Uyên were our wonderful guides for  the tour. They were very knowledgeable and professional in presenting the information throughout the tour. The tour was also engaging with lighthearted trivia-style instead of a monotonous presentation. Every stops we learned something interesting, or we have fun yapping about random everyday life during down time haha.
I think something that's on everyone's mind is the price point of the tour. Yes it's more expensive compare to other tour groups in Saigon and was one of the reasons I used other tours before booking XO tour, but their pricing does make sense. Can't say it's applicable to all other, but some tours are definitely hiring part time drivers while using one licensed guide per tour group. The part time drivers primary purpose is to drive you around, but they are not tour guides themselves. This is not the case for XO. Both Như and Uyên were very knowledgeable and took turn presenting during our tour as a proper tour guide. XO was also more detailed oriented with asking for our passport info to register for insurance. This did not happened with other tours I joined. Basically, it's one of those you get what you pay for kinda thing. Other tours are not necessarily going to provide you a bad experience perse, but with XO you are much more likely to get a good experience because they are doing everything properly.
All in all, if you're clueless about Saigon and are overwhelmed by the amount of info out there like I was, try booking the XO Tours. The time it saves me from doing research itself is already worth the money spent in all honesty. More than that, one of the rewarding parts in traveling in my opinion is the privilege to have others share their stories with you. Every story you hear help you understand something about others and further develop yourself as a person. We had a blast talking with Như and Uyên throughout the tour I think we actually went over the scheduled tour time? 😂 Obviously I wouldn't do the same tour again if the itinerary is identical, but I definitely would look at other XO Tours themselves if I found myself back in Saigon again and you should too.

review_text:
Me and my wife did this tour on 13th feb 2026 and it was a definite highlight of the tour! i would recommend to anyone visiting as its a must do, and it will be first on our to do list when we next visit. The food itself was outstanding. Every stop introduced us to something different and exposed us to dishes we would never have had the confidence to order on our own, but secretly wished we did! The variety was impressive, and each place felt authentic rather than curated purely for tourists. We also got to see and explore large parts of the city we would not have done. Lots of tourists dont really get out of district 1, and this would probably have been us, but through this tour we got to see districts 1, 4,5,8 and 9 and probably others on the way.

Something i really enjoyed that elevated the tour beyond the food was learning about the realities facing young Vietnamese people today. Hearing about the pressures of rapid development, long working hours, family expectations, and the cost of living gave us a much deeper understanding of modern Vietnam. It added a human dimension that you simply do not get from guidebooks or casual sightseeing.

My wife was a bit scared about being on the back of a bike and the traffic but her lovely guides (Lee and Nhi) made us feel really safe and it was really fun.

We left not only full, but better informed and genuinely grateful for the experience. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting HCMC who wants to understand the city through its food and its people.Was definitely worth the money, and my only regret was not doing the other tours they do too, we will be back!

review_text:
A Must-Do Culinary Adventure!

If you are looking for an unforgettable way to experience the heart and soul of Vietnam, look no further than XO Foodie Tours. This wasn't just a food tour; it was a deep dive into the rich culture and history of the city, led by a team that is clearly passionate about what they do.

The Food
The selection of stops was incredible. They took us to hidden gems we never would have discovered on our own, including:
• Bánh Canh Ghẹ BÀ DUYÊN Hùng Vương: Absolute perfection in a bowl.
• Quán Ốc Ngọc & Ốc Loan: These spots offered some of the freshest and most flavorful seafood/shellfish dishes we've ever tasted.

The Expertise
Our tour leader and brand ambassador, Thy, was phenomenal. Her knowledge is vast—she didn't just tell us what we were eating; she explained the "why" behind it. We learned so much about the wet market in Chinatown and the fascinating economic contrast in the districts with luxury apartments. Her insights into the city’s development and economic factors added a layer of education we didn't expect but truly appreciated.

The Atmosphere
The energy was high from start to finish thanks to Nhi and Huong. They are expert hosts who ensured there was never a dull moment. They kept us laughing with ice-breaker games, and even after losing a particularly competitive round of the "peanut chopsticks game," they kept those huge smiles on their faces!

Verdict
XO Foodie Tours provides a perfect balance of education, adventure, and pure fun. You’ll leave with a full stomach and a much deeper understanding of Vietnamese life. Huge thanks to Thy, Nhi, and Huong for making this the highlight of our trip!

review_text: This was far and away the best night of our entire trip. 10 years ago a friend and I went to Vietnam while backpacking south east Asia, and while we were there we met some people who convinced us to do a foodie scootie tour. They said you ride on the back of a Vespa and go around to local restaurants trying out delicious food. I have been talking about that night / tour for a decade! So when my husband and I, and another couple went on this trip, I said that we must do it again. This time though we wanted to book with XO Tours because we loved the idea of an all female company, and it seemed as though they would show us more unique restaurants and foods. We were right! We had already tried the most popular dishes, so going around and trying foods we had never heard of was so fun! All the female drivers / tour guides were so kind and fun, and they made the evening the best night of our whole trip! They are smart, curious and gave us loads of knowledge about customs in the big city and in Vietnam as a whole. We loved how insightful they were, they drove really safe and just made the whole night such a blast! We laughed hard, played games, learned how to properly cheers beers and it made us feel secure taking scooter rides around town on Grab because they helped us with etiquette of riding on scooters. Thank you again for such a memorable night!!! It’s an absolute must book with this company! Do not second guess it.

review_text:
This excursion was one of the best we took in Saigon—if not the best, and certainly one of the most memorable experiences of our entire trip to Vietnam.

This tour also gave us the opportunity to discover Saigon by scooter, in the heart of a city of nearly 9 million inhabitants and millions of scooters. Being accompanied in this impressive flow, with complete confidence, by exclusively female drivers, made the experience unique, safe, and incredibly inspiring.

We felt a real connection with the local culture, but above all, with the people who accompanied us. These young women showed us districts of Saigon that we would never have visited on our own. This allowed us to understand that Saigon is absolutely not limited to District 1; quite the contrary.

On the culinary front, it was a series of delightful surprises: we tasted dishes we would never have dared order on our own… and we devoured them all, they were so delicious.

This tour was also a wonderful opportunity to connect with other international travelers from Spain, Singapore, and Australia, which further enriched the conversations and the atmosphere.

Discovering Saigon through the eyes of the Vietnamese, hearing their stories and their parallels about the country's evolution, from its history to its current transformations, gave this experience a rare depth.

Over the fifteen days of our trip—from Ben Tre to Can Tho, Phu My Tho, Hanoi, and Ho Chi Minh City—this tour was by far the most powerful experience in terms of emotion, connection, and humanity.

A joyful, festive, educational, and profoundly human experience that we will cherish for a very long time.

👉 Don't hesitate to do it. Book without hesitation. We highly recommend booking this Saigon nighttime street food tour – it's truly exceptional.

A precious, authentic, and unforgettable experience 💛

review_text:
Amazing tour, a highlight of our visit to Ho Chi Minh City. The tour takes you off the beaten path to the places outside of normal tourist areas. It is designed to show very different sides of the city - from the old historical parts to the high-end expensive neighborhoods to the night market in Chinatown.

The food is also a not the standard combination of Pho and Banh Mi, but rather things you would not see in an average Vietnamese restaurant outside of Vietnam. From different soups to BBQ to seafood to snails and other exotic dishes (if you are brave enough to try them :)

The guides are very experienced drivers. We were somewhat anxious to take the tour on a scooter, after seeing how crazy the Saigon's traffic is, but we felt completely safe after a couple of meetings of driving. It is actually an attraction by itself to experience the traffic from within.

The organization of the tour is top notch. At every stop there was a person waiting and helping with the scooters, the was never any wait time in the restaurants. Everything moved as a well-oiled machine.

The routes are also very well designed, taking you through the night Saigon full of lights and night life. The time on the backseat of the scooter was actually more magical than the food tasting itself.

Overall, one of the best tours I've taken in my life. Lots of thanks to our wonderful drivers and to the tour organizers. Highly recommend!

review_text: We went on the XO Foodie Tour on 2 Jan. The 4.5 hours whizzed by so quickly as we were brought around 5 districts in HCMC with stops for tasting local food and for sightseeing. Through the hard work and effort of Ngoc Tran (Nora as we call her) and her team, we saw the different 'faces' of HCMC- in one moment, we are in a noisy, crowded wet market overflowing with fresh fruits and live poultry. In another instance, we are in a quiet, clean and posh residential area with a huge park and waterfront. The tour guides are amazing- they are always engaging you in conversation while riding their bikes and navigating the infamous traffic conditions! Just trust them and enjoy the experience!

review_text:
We did a tour with XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City and it was excellent. The company is run entirely by women, which gives the experience a distinctive character. Each guest rides on the back of a motorbike with a driver, navigating the busy streets of Saigon. It is exciting and feels safe throughout.

The tour combines street food, local restaurants, and clear explanations of Vietnamese culture, daily life, and the city’s history. We tried a wide range of dishes and learned why they matter, not just what they are. The guides were knowledgeable, organised, and easy to talk to.

Moving through the city, stopping to eat, and listening to stories about Saigon made this one of the best ways to understand the city in a short time.

Highly, highly recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting HCMC who wants to experience the city like a local!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
The XO Foodie tour was easily one of the highlights of my trip. It felt very authentic because they actually take you out to explore different districts instead of just staying in the touristy District 1. It was actually drizzling right from the start during hotel pickup, but the team was totally prepared and it didn’t dampen the mood at all.

There was so much variety in the food and everything was incredible, but the staff really made the experience. My guide, Khloe, was an absolute gem - she was professional, easy to talk to, and constantly checked in on me to make sure I was doing okay. I was traveling solo and never felt like an outcast; the group dynamic just felt very natural and inclusive from the beginning. Khloe and the tour leader, Yen, also shared some really interesting nuggets of info regarding Vietnamese history and culture, which added a lot of depth to the stops. The other ladies and guides were also incredibly friendly and informative throughout the night.

We also had a fun mini-game during one of the stops, which was a nice touch to keep the energy up. Another huge plus is that they took photos of us throughout the night and sent them to us afterward, so I didn't have to worry about missing any memories. If you want a fun, well-organized way to see the real Saigon, this is worth every cent.

review_text:
We had no idea what we were in for on this tour! We thought it was just about food. We were met by 4 lovely young ladies who picked us up on their motorbikes. They reassured us it was very safe. “Like fish swimming”. Because Saigon has A LOT of motorbikes! And cars and van and buses. We were whisked off to our first stop where our education began. Not only did we learn about the local food, we also learned about the city structure and life for the locals in Saigon. We walked around at stops between food stops to stimulate the appetite. We walked through a night market, and our guides bought local fruit. At one of our food stops, they cut up the fruit and we were able to try fruit I had never seen before. But it is easy to recognize, and I I would be comfortable buying during the rest of my trip to Vietnam.
Overall, this was an amazing experience. I learned so much and ate so much! The food was excellent and our guides were excellent. Everyone in my group agrees. This was a 10/10.

place_name: XO Tours - Saigon Food Tours and City Tours Led by Women
review_text:
Do this tour!!! One of the guys on our tour had done it 3 times it was that good!

We did another food tour a few nights prior and although the food was good (all Michelin restaurants) the tour was underwhelming and we left disappointed.

This tour was the opposite!
From the word go all the girls were professional, we got clear instructions on how to ride the scooters, where we were going and in what order (restaurant, sightseeing, restaurant, sightseeing, restaurant), where there would be bathrooms, confirmed any food allergies or dislikes we had and then we were off.

Both Becky and Katie were great drivers, calmly and safely navigating rush hour traffic all while chatting away to us. Every guide was bubbly and genuinely interested to talk with us about life in Vietnam and our lives and countries as well.

The girls all spoke fantastic English, were very bright and well educated which made for interesting conversations.

The “sightseeing stops” were in unusual areas of the town, specifically chosen to highlight Saigon’s history and future and to give you a glimpse into the lives of the people that live here.

Alongside the drivers/guides, they had a lead guide for our group of 10 with no passenger who organised the group and spoke to us at each stop with information about the area, people and traditions. They also had 4 support guys who went to the restaurants in advance to ensure they were ready for us and to support them. This ensured the night flowed very smoothly.

At the restaurants the girls ensured we were all having fun, the drinks and food were free flowing (the boys had 4 dishes of scallops they were so good!)
We loved that they sat with us and were involved during meal times, it meant we got a lot more interaction and made the evening a lot of fun.

This was an exceptionally well organized tour, great guides, good food and a lot of fun, you’ll love it.

review_text:
My mum and I had the best time on 2 different XO TOURS during our time in Saigon:

First, we did the Foodie Tour with amazing guides Tao and Thang. The two guides were so kind, fun, articulate and knowledgeable and extremely safe and capable drivers. We saw 5 districts and ate a variety of amazing local dishes. They even surprised me with a cake for my birthday that had happened the week prior. My mums favourite stop was through the chinatown fruit market, and our guides picked up some exotic fruits for us to try. Overall, we absolutely loved our guides and this tour and would highly recommend.

We had such a great time on the food tour we also went on the XO Sights of Saigon tour which was a cultural and historical tour of Saigon with amazing guides Linh and Truc. They taught us so much about Vietnamese history, religion, politics and culture and showed us fascinating sights including a secret bunker used to smuggle weapons during the war. Our guides were extremely kind, fun and happily answered all of our questions along the way. We also had a delicious lunch with our awesome guides.

Our only regret is that we could not do the Saigon by Night tour.

My mum stated those tours were here favourite part of visiting multiple countries in Asia over a three week trip.

We love XO Tours!

review_text:
The scooter tour in Saigon was unforgettable.
The two wonderful women who rode with us were not just guides, they opened a window into real life in Vietnam. With their kindness, patience, and big smiles, they showed us how people live, how they truly support one another, and how mutual help is simply a natural part of daily life.

They also introduced us to street food that was incredibly fresh and delicious, a taste of Vietnam we would never have discovered on our own.

The adrenaline was high, yet at the same time we felt completely safe riding with them, thanks to their confidence and calm presence.

I was deeply impressed by the founder of this amazing women’s group. Knowing that 120 women work together with such strength, solidarity, and shared purpose made the whole experience even more meaningful.

It was a special moment of connection, learning, and genuine warmth.

review_text:
One of my favorite experiences during our time in Vietnam! Our tour leader Yen, and drivers Ha and Anh, were absolutely wonderful. I truly believe we had the best drivers of the night! We had a blast riding as passengers on a motorbike, which I feel like should be the main reason you choose this tour. Note, the company provides travel insurance for the motorbikes, which shows attention to customer safety. Our drivers were constantly engaging us in conversation, sharing their knowledge and experiences while also asking questions to show their interest. All the food we had were dishes that locals would eat and not your typical pho, banh mi, etc. I appreciated that our tour was followed by a handful of male employees that made sure we were safe and looked after. I was also absolutely floored that Yen remembered every single one of our 15 tour members’ names from the beginning to the end of the tour! I really felt the passion and dedication of all the XO employees. My favorite stop of the 3 food destinations was the last seafood place, where we were allowed to order more of whatever dishes we tried and enjoyed. Our drivers sat next to us and made sure we were well take care of the entire time.

Overall, I was surprised we only stopped at 3 places to eat. The other 2 destinations were a wet market and a short stop at a neighborhood. While the detours between the food stops were fun and insightful, I think only 1 stop is really needed. I do understand its purpose though, since you’re not really walking between destinations so you do need time to digest. I just felt it wasn’t a necessary part of the tour and could have been replaced with more food destination. We also did not receive a final list of the places we visited, which is a shame because we wanted to revisit the seafood eatery again.

Overall, I would still highly recommend this food tour to any first time visitor of Vietnam interested in experiencing being on a motorbike and trying local cuisine! A lot of tourists we met did the same tour and were equally delighted with their experience. I would definitely be interested in checking out their other tour options in the future! I do appreciate the response from the company and our tour guide did reach out after, as I had misplaced the business card they provided at the end of our tour and forgot they did mention we could message them afterwards with any questions. Thank you Yen!

owner_response:
10 months ago
Hi Stephanie! Thank you for your thorough review of the XO Foodie tour. I am happy to hear that you enjoyed your time with us and the food we served on the tour.

In regards to the 2 sightseeing stops, they're not only meant only to give you time to digest the food from the food stops but also to offer our guests a chance to see the drastic differences between the various districts in Saigon. Most of our guests love the 2 stops but we understand not every guests will enjoy every location. 

Last of all, you probably recalled that your tour leader Yen gave you her name card and told you to feel free to message her if you needed any additional help or information while in Vietnam. She would have been happy to provide you with the address of the last seafood eatery if you messaged her. 

Our tours leaders are given the discretion to order the dishes they feel will be most suitable for their group, due to food restrictions, nationalities, etc. so your group would have had a very different menu to another group led by a different leader. 

We do not provide a final list of all the places and dishes for the tour, because the list of foods and restaurants can differ drastically from tour to tour, and it would require a ton of extra work to update the list for the 4-5 different tour groups we take out every night. 

That being said, when the tour leaders send out the tour photos, they will also provide the list of stops and dishes upon request.

review_text:
XO tours are a very professional organisation based in HCMC (Saigon) specialising in motorbike tours around the outer districts of the City.
My husband and I are both on the wrong side of 70, and we both felt safe, well looked after & very much part of the group.
The young ladies are allocated a passenger for the night, and they take their job seriously. They miss oncoming traffic, pot holes & all sorts of other dangers that present themselves to you in this busy metropolis.
We had Vy & Quynh as our drivers - who were brilliant.
We visited a fruit market, we ate some delicious food in out of the way places we would never have found & experienced being immersed in the Vietnamese way of life - which is travelling on a motorbike.

We had a small group led by Linh along with Cam and Ngoc. We rode pillion behind the girls which felt very safe, allowing us to focus on the scenery and stories. The pace was perfect, fast enough to cover ground, but slow enough to take it all in. Our guides shared incredible insights into the real Saigon—past and present—far beyond what you’d find in a guidebook.
Our guides were exceptional, they were very knowledgeable, passionate, and genuinely proud of their city’s complex history. This tour is perfect for history lovers, culture enthusiasts, and anyone looking to connect with Saigon beyond the tourist trail. Highly recommended as a first activity when you arrive in the city — it sets the tone for everything else.
Thank you for a wonderful morning, we even liked experiencing the sudden downpour of rain towards the end of our ride!

review_text:
I booked with XO tours twice (May 2019 & August 2025) and enjoyed both experiences. I was thinking of booking with another company and I’m glad I didn’t. We purchased the additional video footage which I thought was worth it. Although I booked the Saigon by night twice, I feel like they were both different experiences despite it being with the same company.

During the August 2025 booking, we were able to visit a different part of the city and learn about the recent changes affecting the area as it attempts to gentrify. We were served food and drinks, which were definitely not items I’ve tried before but glad I was able to eat them since they were soooo yummy!! All the girls that were our tour guides were so sweet, easy to connect with and just genuinely the kindest people. I enjoyed hearing their stories and how they love working with XO tours. Since it was my second time with them, they gave me a unique token of appreciation to take home with me! My tour guide also sent me some recommendations after of different places to try.

Would definitely go again to try the foodie tour or the sight seeing around the city.

review_text:
We took a tour with a company called XO Tours.  They are a ladies only tour company that offer various tours around Ho Chi Min.
We took an evening tour on scooters where they zipped us around different parts of the city and learnt about genuine Vietnamese culture. We visited a local market where we picked up fruit, then a meat/fish market.
They took us to district 10, which is where a lot of the locals live and enjoyed eating with them and enjoying their local dishes (not banh mi or pho)
After that we were invited into one of our guides family home which was really special.  The family was so accommodating and honestly it brought me down to earth, knowing they have so little.
I haven't stopped thinking about them since the tour, which shows what an impact they made on me.
They have next to nothing, yet are happy and greatful with what they do have.
We met as strangers and left as friends. It was wonderful and if you're in Ho Chi Min, please check them out

review_text:
We took part in the ‘Saigon by Night’ tour and really enjoyed the experience. Saigon is a fascinating city and this tour gives a real insight into life there that a ‘normal’ tour is unlikely to give. Our guides were charming, knowledgeable and full of genuine pride in what they were doing. They were so enthusiastic about what they were showing us and this experience was a highlight of our stay in Saigon. Plus their English was perfect.

There was just about enough food (we had a teenage boy with us) and if you want more it’s pretty cheap to add extra courses if you need. It was delicious and our guides set everything up for us and were perfect hosts. Visiting Ms Hong’s family apartment was a privilege and didn’t feel in the least bit awkward or patronizing.

We were pleased to join this tour and feel that we were supporting such a talented group of people.
Just one tip - because of the poor air quality in Saigon make sure you have high quality face masks that protect against the air pollution, being on the bikes you are much more exposed to it and really notice the fumes.

Highly recommended!!

review_text:
We had a great experience with Giang and the XO Tours team on the XO Foodie Tour, riding on the back of scooters across five districts of Saigon. The girls did a fantastic job making us feel safe and welcome throughout the night. My guide, Becky, was especially great — she was really engaging, shared lots of interesting information about the city, and asked insightful questions that sparked good conversation. She was also an expert scooter driver, which made the whole ride smooth and enjoyable. As a cultural experience, this was excellent — we got a great background on the city, saw parts of Saigon we’d never have visited on our own, and the attention to detail from the guides was impressive.

However, as a food tour or culinary experience, I found it quite disappointing. The restaurants and dishes felt randomly selected and not particularly exciting. In my opinion, most tourists with a bit of a sense of adventure could find better food on their own just by exploring District 1 or other tourist areas and trying food from street corner restaurants, barbecue spots and roadside stalls. Even while we were at the restaurants, the focus was mostly on explaining life in the city and activities rather than the food itself. That made it harder to enjoy the meals or feel like the food was a highlight of the tour.

I’d still highly recommend XO Tours as a company  the experience was fantastic, but I think the Saigon by Night tour might offer better value overall. If you're booking the XO Foodie Tour, go in with the right expectations, it's more about the city and culture than the food.

a year ago
Hi Rory! 

We're so happy that you enjoyed your time with us! We're sorry you didn't enjoy the food as much as the rest of the tour. The dishes we offer on the tour are definitely not "randomly selected" as you stated however. We provide a clear summary on the tour, why we chose the places we visit, and the dishes we serve on the tour. 

Saigon is  a huge city and we know that most travelers to Saigon will never be able to explore all the 24 districts on their own, so we take guests through 5 unique Districts to show them the huge contrasts between the different areas. As you mentioned, areas you would never had visited on your own. These distinct Districts also specialize in very different types of street food. The place we took you to in District 8 specialized in goat hot pot, and very few people have had an opportunity to try goat meat, that's why we took you there. And District 4, the last district we visited specialized in different types of shellfish and seafood.  We serve 10-12 dishes on the tour, and all these dishes are the same types of dishes that we, and our staff love to each when we visit these eateries. We understand that everyone has different tastes however, so it's impossible to please everyone. 

For travelers like yourself that prefer more typical and less adventurous Vietnamese dishes, we agree that the Saigon by Night Tour would probably have been a more appropriate option.

review_text: My friend and I took the Foodie Tour and it was by far the highlight of our trip to Saigon. It was a thrill from start to finish. This was the fourth time that I took the XO Foodie Tour. I enjoyed it so much the first three times that I wanted my friend to also experience it. The XO Tour company is very organized and easy to work with. Booking was very easy and the support leading up to the tour was excellent. Ms. Nguyen, the XO Tour Booking Manager that I corresponded with prior to the tour, was very professional and responsive. The food and drinks at all stops were delicious and plentiful. We had crab noodle soup, Vietnamese BBQ, an assortment of seafood dishes, local fruits and desserts, and a lot of beer. We were offered as much food and beer as we wanted. I like the fact that we went to local restaurants off the beaten path and were offered unique dishes that we would have not have normally ordered. But the best part of the trip was our guides. My driver and guide Nga (aka Nana) was amazing and made the evening so much fun. She has such a wonderful personality; so friendly and talkative; very fluent in English. And Nana’s motorbike driving skills were superb. I felt very safe and thoroughly enjoyed the exhilarating ride through Saigon. Our tour team leader, Lucy, also did a fantastic job that evening. She provided informative discussions along the way about the food, Vietnamese culture, living in Saigon, and the history. Lucy executed the tour with confidence, excellent leadership, and professionalism. She was very articulate and enthusiastic when she spoke. Lucy also took photos of us at strategic locations and sent them to us after the tour. It was nice to not have to worry about taking my own photos during our tour and just focus on enjoying the experience and conversation with our guides. I highly recommend this tour! This is the top tour in Saigon in my opinion. I would even take it a fifth time!

This wasn’t just a food tour it was a deep, delicious dive into the heart and soul of Ho Chi Minh City, led by an incredible group of woman who brings passion, warmth, and authenticity to every stop.

We wandered through lively backstreets, hidden alleyways, and local wet markets that tourists wouldn’t usually find on their own. Each tasting was better than the last from melt-in-your-mouth to the richest, most comforting bowl of soup I’ve ever had. She even introduced us to lesser-known specialties.

What made this tour so special wasn’t just the food (although that alone is worth every second) — it was their warmth, humor, and her deep knowledge of the culture and history behind what we were eating. They made us feel like friends, not just guests. It was empowering and inspiring to be guided by women so passionate about their city and heritage.

We had sooo much fun with the other people who also joined us on the tour.
Highly recommend this to anyone wanting to go beyond the tourist track and connect with Saigon on a deeper level.

Thank you for such an unforgettable experience ❤️

review_text:
Unforgettable Evening with XO Tours – Saigon by Night

We had a truly memorable experience with XO Tours’ Saigon by Night tour. What made it exceptional were our wonderful guide and driver, Hồng and Nguyen. Both were engaging and warm, but it was Hồng’s heartfelt stories about her childhood neighborhood that truly moved us.

The tour gave us a perfect blend of flavors and culture — from savoring delicious street food to exploring the bustling Xóm Vôi market. What stood out most was the visit to a local home. It offered an intimate glimpse into everyday life in Saigon — challenging at times, yet filled with resilience and quiet joy.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants more than just a tourist’s view of the city.

review_text:
We’re a group of 7 coworkers visiting HCMC. I was researching food tours and this one was consistently recommended, even on Reddit. I was about to book a cheaper tour with a different provider but changed my mind and booked XO instead. I’m so glad I did!

Their communication is prompt and clear. Everyone in the group had an amazing time and enjoyed chatting with the guides. We all felt safe riding the scooters, the ladies are cautious drivers. This is hands down one of the best tours I’ve ever attended in any country, and I’ve travelled quite a lot. We visited “tiny uncle” in his home, allowing us to visit a very local home you’d never be able to visit otherwise. The guides were fun and engaging the whole time, we all loved it and such a great time. I’m grateful we made some fun memories!  Thanks to Giang the lead guide who took excellent care of us. Even at the food stops they would nicely peel our fruit and crabs! 5-star service!!! It rained during our tour and they were prepared with ponchos and goggles, very helpful because the rain was heavy.

Book with XO, you won’t regret it. Though they seem more expensive, once you attend you’ll realise what incredible value it is.

review_text:
A fantastic way to see and eat through Saigon!

Myself and a group of friends went on the XO food tour a few nights ago and had an amazing time! We travelled to five different locations, which included three different meal spots featuring multiple unique dishes, and two sightseeing destinations that helped provide some cool background for the city as a whole. I’m still thinking about some of the food we ate on the tour because of how delicious it was, and I’m so grateful that this was one of the first things we experienced upon arriving in Saigon.

The tour itself was phenomenal, and the women we were paired with who drove us from location to location were an amazing group with great energy, enthusiasm and knowledge. Even through rain that persisted on and off through the tour, our guides made sure that we had a fun time and that we were enjoying ourselves — they really treated us like friends that they were sharing their city with. In particular, my guide/driver Tien had such a warm and fun demeanor, and she was extremely open, answering any questions that I had during the tour. Riding on her bike and getting to chat and laugh in between each stop was another major highlight of the tour for me. Overall, our group had a ton of fun, and the connections we made with our group made this a truly unforgettable experience!! Highly recommended for first time visitors to Saigon! 😋🇻🇳

review_text:
We moved to Saigon in late 2024 and hadn’t yet heard the buzz about XO Tours. I happened to run into two of their drivers outside our serviced apartment and asked them about it…..and I’m so glad I did! Taking the tour turned out to be a truly uplifting experience.

There’s a real sense of freedom riding on the back of the bike and the drivers are fantastic ….friendly, engaging and most importantly, we felt completely safe through (sometimes!) hectic traffic! They struck up genuine conversations and made us feel so welcome.

The three food stops were excellent and the two sightseeing stops were equally fab. We actually now regularly dine at one of the places they took us to!

When the girls found out that we live in Saigon, they went out of their way to share great tips on local spots and hidden gems.

XO is organised and professional and for that you do pay a premium - approx. AUD 125 per person.

We moved to Saigon in late 2024 and hadn’t yet heard the buzz about XO Tours. I happened to run into two of their drivers outside our serviced apartment and asked them about it…..and I’m so glad I did! Taking the tour turned out to be a truly uplifting experience.

There’s a real sense of freedom riding on the back of the bike and the drivers are fantastic ….friendly, engaging and most importantly, we felt completely safe through (sometimes!) hectic traffic! They struck up genuine conversations and made us feel so welcome.

The three food stops were excellent and the two sightseeing stops were equally fab. We actually now regularly dine at one of the places they took us to!

When the girls found out that we live in Saigon, they went out of their way to share great tips on local spots and hidden gems.

XO is organised and professional and for that you do pay a premium - approx. AUD 125 per person.

This was a wonderful and unexpected experience and since then, we always recommend XO Tours to our endless guests visiting us from home.

review_text:
I had the most incredible experience on this epic food and scooter tour through Ho Chi Minh City on May 13, 2025! We explored 5 different districts, each with its own flavor and charm, and enjoyed 3 delicious meals that truly showcased the variety of Vietnamese cuisine.

Our guides, Thao 9 and Ngoc Tran, were both absolutely amazing—so friendly, knowledgeable, and made the night feel like a local adventure with friends. Riding on the back of the scooter through crazy Saigon traffic could’ve been intimidating, but Thao 9 navigated it like a pro and made me feel completely safe and at ease the entire time. Liz rode with Ngoc Tran and had just as great an experience!

To top it all off, they found out this was my birthday trip and surprised me with a birthday cake at our final food stop. Such a thoughtful and unforgettable gesture!

If you’re looking to dive into the food scene and culture of Saigon in a fun, immersive way, I highly recommend this tour!

Both Giang and Ai were wonderful tour guides with a wealth of knowledge and were excited to show us what Saigon had to offer, - not to mention their superb driving skills through Saigon traffic! review_text:
On April 28th, 2025—just one day before my birthday—I had the absolute pleasure of joining the evening food tour with XO Tours in Ho Chi Minh City, and it turned out to be one of the most unforgettable experiences of my travels.

From the start, I felt completely safe, welcomed, and at ease. As a solo female traveler, I specifically chose XO Tours because it’s run by women and led by an incredible team of local female guides. My guide, Nhi, was absolutely wonderful. As we zipped through the vibrant streets of Saigon, we bonded over shared stories and personal conversations. It felt less like a guided tour and more like an adventure with a friend.

The food we sampled throughout the night was delicious and authentic, but what truly elevated the experience were the cultural stops. This wasn’t just about eating—it was about understanding Vietnam’s history, daily life, and traditions. It was deeper than just a food tour; it was a meaningful journey through the heart of the city.

And just when I thought the night couldn’t get any better, the team surprised me by singing Happy Birthday and presenting me with a small birthday cake. It was such a thoughtful, heartwarming gesture that made me feel incredibly special.

I wholeheartedly recommend XO Tours to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City, especially solo female travelers. It’s more than just a tour—it’s a connection, a cultural experience, and a memory I’ll cherish forever.

review_text: We had the most incredible time on this tour and without doubt was one of the highlights of our holiday! We've been on other food tours in Asia which we'd loved but this was by far the most exceptional. Being driven around on scooters through the Saigon traffic was a lot of fun. I felt surprisingly very safe and we travelled far more distance through different districts than I imagined we would. My pre-teens loved every minute too and said it was an experience they'd remember forever. The XO girls are an asset to the tour- they had an exceptional way of putting us at ease, with very high level English and looked after us so well- with games and surprising facts about Vietnam. I learnt so much about life in Saigon. They went out of their way to ensure we enjoyed every minute of the tour- eg. Taking our girls off for ice-creams and a game whilst we learnt about the financial side/ facts of living in Vietnam. My husband was keen to buy fruit at the market and they haggled for us then gave them to him as a gift. So kind. They were incredibly enthusiastic and keen to have fun- dancing to the live music in the street and a bit of cheating with the chopstick game! I could tell we were being well cared for with the XO men driving alongside, making sure they arrived ready to greet us with cold beers! It was a pricey experience for Vietnam but worth every penny and would return to do this tour again! Thank you so much to the XO tour girls- you made our holiday!
